observations.behavior: Adds conditional guard before emitting alerts; also adds two new registration fields and a test for their dependency. P1.F7.H1 removes dry-run and rollout-percentage overrides, replacing them with access-control and an explicit 'emits_alerts=False' flag. P1.F8.H3 updates assertions and comments to reflect the removal of dry-run and the new access-control fields.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the health check alert emission behavior: alerts are no longer emitted unconditionally; they are emitted only if the check class explicitly allows it or if the class is not None.
